excerpt: BetterClaw is a no-code platform from New Delhi for building AI agents that run on a schedule in Slack, Telegram, Discord or Gmail, using your own AI key. Pricing, alternatives and launch-day questions.
content:
BetterClaw lets you build an AI agent without code or a server. You describe the job in chat, connect the tools it needs (Gmail, Slack, Notion, HubSpot, Stripe and many more), give it a schedule, and it runs the task and reports back in Slack, Telegram, Discord or Gmail. Typical jobs on its site are inbox triage, morning briefings, competitor checks and posting updates. Each agent runs in its own sandboxed container, and the makers say the agent never touches OAuth tokens directly.

Two choices set it apart. You bring your own AI key (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, DeepSeek, Groq, or a local model through Ollama, among 28+ providers), and BetterClaw says it never marks up those token costs; it charges for the platform. And agents work at trust levels: they start as Interns that ask before acting, and you promote them to Specialist or Lead by hand when you trust them with more.

BetterClaw is built by BitQit Private Limited, a small software company in New Delhi, India, whose About page lists a team across tech, marketing and support. It launched on Product Hunt on 11 August 2026 and finished #2 for the day with 310 points and 61 comments.

We have not tested BetterClaw ourselves. This page brings together its official site, its Product Hunt page and the public pages of the products it is compared with, and says where each fact comes from.

profile.platform: Web app, with an iOS app
profile.summary_short: No-code platform for scheduled AI agents that work across your tools, using your own AI key

gallery.alt: BetterClaw's new scheduled task screen with frequency, time, timezone, agent and cron fields, under the heading 'Schedule tasks to run automatically'
BetterClaw graphic 'Connect 96 tools in one click' showing Gmail, Slack, QuickBooks, Salesforce, HubSpot, Notion, GitHub and other connector logos
BetterClaw banner 'Build your first agent today' noting a free plan with no credit card, 200+ skills, 96 connectors and 15+ chat platforms

fit: want an agent that runs recurring jobs (briefings, inbox triage, competitor checks) without setting up Docker or a server
already pay for an AI model and want to use your own key without a markup
want agents to ask before acting until you trust them
not_fit: want to self-host and control the whole stack: BetterClaw is managed infrastructure (its own comparison pages call self-hosting a reasonable choice)
need more than one agent or 100 credits a month for free: those are the free plan's limits
need fine-grained custom rules for when an agent must ask: the makers say permissions are role-based for now

pricing.intro: BetterClaw has a free plan and three paid plans, in US dollars. Every plan uses your own AI key, so model costs are billed by your provider, not by BetterClaw.

plans.name: Free
plans.detail: 1 agent, 100 credits a month, 3 connectors, 7-day memory retention, no card needed

plans.name: Basic
plans.detail: 1 agent, 500 credits a month, 10 connectors, 2 vCPU / 4 GB server, 7-day memory, community support

plans.name: Pro
plans.detail: $39/month billed annually. 5 agents, 12,000 credits a month, unlimited connectors, ad integrations, 90-day memory, 2 team seats, 24-hour email support

plans.name: Business
plans.detail: $119/month billed annually. 25 agents, 40,000 credits a month, unlimited memory, 5 team seats, dedicated server, 12-hour priority support

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.detail: Unlimited agents, custom credits, SSO and a dedicated account manager

notes: Every paid plan has a 7-day money-back guarantee and can be cancelled any time.
Extra agents and seats cost extra (for example, on Pro an extra agent is $12/month and a seat $10/month).
According to the terms, if you run out of credits, extra credit packs are billed automatically at your plan's rate.
On Product Hunt the maker said the free allowance was 500 credits a month; BetterClaw's pricing and About pages now say 100.

alternatives.intro: These are products Product Hunt lists as alternatives. Review scores are Product Hunt users' own.

items.name: Pickaxe
items.what: Build AI agents and sell them through branded portals
items.difference: Aimed at selling agents to clients, with billing and access control built in, rather than running your own scheduled jobs.

items.name: Agentplace
items.what: AI agents that answer customers and book appointments
items.difference: Customer-facing agents with a free built-in model, while BetterClaw runs internal work with your own model key.

items.name: Claude by Anthropic
items.difference: A general assistant; BetterClaw can use Claude as one of the models behind a scheduled agent.

alternatives.more: Product Hunt also lists Skydive and MakersClaw. On Product Hunt the maker described BetterClaw as a managed layer on top of the Hermes agent runtime, and its site has comparison pages against OpenClaw, Claude Cowork, Hermes Agent and others.

quotes.author: Michael Vavilov
quotes.text: What triggers the a promotion from intern to specialist?
quotes.reply: Shabnam Katoch: promotion is manual for now; you review what the agent has done and promote it when you are comfortable.

quotes.author: Mohsin Ali
quotes.text: what happens if an API rate limits the agent midtask?
quotes.reply: Tina Chhabra: the agent waits and retries without losing progress, and escalates to you if it can't resolve it.

quotes.author: Stefano Galfrè
quotes.text: Is it really going to be 0$ forever?
quotes.reply: Shabnam Katoch: yes, with a monthly credit allowance that resets.

faq.a: A no-code platform for building AI agents that run on a schedule and work across tools such as Gmail, Slack and Notion. It is built by BitQit Private Limited of New Delhi and launched on Product Hunt on 11 August 2026.

There is a free plan with no card required: 1 agent, 100 credits a month, 3 connectors and 7-day memory. Paid plans are Basic at $19 a month, Pro at $49 and Business at $149. You also pay your AI provider directly for model usage.

faq.q: Which AI models does it support?
faq.a: It works with your own key from 28+ providers, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, DeepSeek and Groq, or local models through Ollama. BetterClaw says it adds no markup to token costs.
On BetterClaw's managed infrastructure. Its sub-processor list names Railway, Fly.io (sandboxed agent runtimes), Cloudflare and Google Cloud, with Composio brokering connections to your tools.

faq.q: Can an agent act without my approval?
faq.a: New agents start as Interns that ask before acting. You can promote an agent to Specialist or Lead by hand, and move it back down at any time, according to the makers.
Every new paid subscription has a 7-day money-back guarantee, according to BetterClaw's terms and pricing page.
